title: Weapon part placement: shared weapon skeleton, vertex bone binding and per-weapon pose resources
question: Some 1P weapon mesh parts are stored away from where they sit on the gun (barrels of VSSM, M87A1, RPKM, RPK-74M, M240L; rear sights of M121 A2, Z84M, L110; revolver cylinders; pistol slides). Where do the files record the placement?
answer: Every 1P weapon mesh vertex is bound to one bone of Common/Characters/_Soldier/_WeaponSkeleton (66 bones, one skeleton for all weapons, generic bind positions). Meshes are stored at the bind positions. Each weapon has a pose resource (P_WepAtt_<W>_01, or P_1P_<W>_Stand_Idle_01 where there is none) holding the weapon's own bone transforms. Placement = pose(bone) x inverse bind(bone) x stored vertex, relative to Wep_Align.

sources.poseResources: reports/wepatt-poses-2026-11-18/res (70, export-res needle p_wepatt_) and res-idle (64, P_1P_<W>_Stand_Idle_01)
sources.dofSets: reports/wepatt-dofs-2026-11-18 and reports/wepatt-dofsets-2026-11-18 (Soldier.Fullbody.WepParts.DSL and its 25 DofSets)
sources.script: reports/wepatt-poses-2026-11-18/wep_pose.py (prints the transform per bone: python wep_pose.py <pose name ...>)

layout: See docs/frosty/FIELD_MAP.md, rows for the weapon skeleton, MeshSet bone elements and resType 4088bf7e.

checks.measuredBefore: barrel y -21.4 (front post tip against MD.Sight.Main y)
rear sight turned -90 deg about x, then +16.5, +38.9, +198.1 (screenshot fit)

otherChecks: Wep_Charm.t on MG5 holds the skeleton bind value (25.1, 67.9, 162.5 mm).
Wep2_IK_RightHand repeats Wep_IK_RightHand in both blocks.
MG5, VSSM and PKM: weapon channels of the idle pose equal those of the attachment pose.
590A1: the 245-channel idle pose matches its 247-channel attachment pose at quaternion offset 0 and translation offset -1.

With the pose applied, the front post tip height equals MD.Sight.Main / MD.FrontSight.Main y within 0.5 mm on the weapons that were off before (RPK-74M 89.6 / 89.6, M240L 128.3 / 128.7, M45A1 52.5 / 52.5); this also accounts for the 53 to 59 mm pistol offset noted on 17 November.
Rotation convention: standard quaternion-to-matrix for column vectors; the transposed form puts the L110 rear sight 60 mm under the sight line.
limits: Channel names are assigned by position from the end of each block, not by the channel hash list (ToolChannelToDofAssetData Field_6eaf60bd, 247 hashes; the hash of a dof name was not found). Only the weapon channels were checked.
6 of 134 pose resources use another layout (first u32 26 or 2, or 242 / 243 / 2258 / 6690 channels) and are not read: USG-90 and BRoD-3 have no readable pose and are drawn as stored.
Animated channels are read at frame 0.
Bones that a gamestate drives at run time (MD.AttachOffset.*, MD.AttachPoint.*) are not added; they apply to attachments, not to the gun's own parts.
ruledOut: MD_<W> part records: 43 MD.* gamestates, none places a barrel or a sight leaf.
Mesh EBX: references only its LOD group.
Mesh .res: no bone-name hashes, no per-part transforms; only the per-vertex bone index.
No per-weapon skeleton asset exists in the catalog.
